Commit 8bca0804fc794e511c5968b5d79c0b3246a6fffe in re-cinq/Otto
Author: Saad
Date: 2026-10-15T13:07:10Z
Parents: adda357e2ff2d056c3b6159e55cf315224c77a7f
Link: https://github.com/re-cinq/Otto/commit/8bca0804fc794e511c5968b5d79c0b3246a6fffe

Connect the TMS tools to the TMS client, on a stand-in TMS until OLT's key arrives

TMS_MODE is required and is off, stand-in or live (#399). off registers no
TMS tool, as today. stand-in and live register get_booking_status through
one TMS client built at startup: stand-in replays the made-up responses in
apps/api/stand-in-tms and never leaves the process, answering a reference
it holds nothing for as OLT's API answers an unknown one, and warns
tms.stand_in once; live reaches an https TMS_BASE_URL with TMS_API_KEY.

## Approach

- No tool or `TmsCall` signature carries the key, and the client still reads no credential itself, which settles RD-2 on #16's side.
  - `tmsKeyLeakTurn.test.ts` drives a composed turn on the live connection with the TMS answering 500. The key goes out on every attempt and reaches no frame, tool result, audit row, escalation row or log line. `toolCrashTurn` now shares that composition (`test/fixtures/composedTurn.ts`).
- **Authority:** `get_booking_status` gets a `read_only` row in the authority table, which `docs/human-oversight.md` lists.
- **Chart:**
  - `api.tmsMode` is required and is `stand-in` or `live`. Live also needs `api.tmsBaseUrl` and the Secret `api.tmsSecretName`, key `apiKey`; the key never goes in a values file.
  - A CI step pins the default render and refuse…

## Context

Provides the startup configuration needed to reach the real TMS or fall back to the stand-in mode.

## What to change

Read TMS_MODE and TMS_API_KEY at startup in config.ts. Ensure startup fails if live mode lacks the key. Update charts/otto/values.yaml to validate api.tmsMode and api.tmsSecretName.

Target file: `apps/api/src/configuration/config.ts`

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Startup fails when TMS_MODE is live and TMS_API_KEY is missing.
- [ ] Helm chart refuses to render without valid TMS mode configuration.

## How to test

Add unit tests in tmsConfig.test.ts asserting startup throws under invalid configurations.

## References

- [specs/support-agent-tms-access/spec.md#functional-requirements](https://github.com/re-cinq/otto/blob/HEAD/specs/support-agent-tms-access/sp…

[1] "pull-403" section 1:
Pull request #403 in re-cinq/Otto: Connect the TMS tools to the TMS client, on a stand-in TMS until OLT's key arrives
State: merged
Author: saadahmed95
Opened: 2026-10-15T13:07:32Z
Closed: 2026-10-16T13:26:50Z
Merged: 2026-10-16T13:26:50Z
Link: https://github.com/re-cinq/Otto/pull/403

Closes #399. Stacked on #402; it retargets to `main` when #402 merges.

**Merge order: #402, then #405, then this.** This PR switches `recinq-test` to the stand-in, which registers `get_booking_status`. #405 teaches the web app to draw the tool's delivery card, so it has to be deployed first; otherwise testers get answers rendered as a card nobody sees.

## Why

#18 left FR-040 and FR-041 to this issue: `TMS_API_KEY` is read once at startup, kept out of every tool signature, and a missing key stops the api. Nothing in `apps/api` read the key, because no tool was connected to `@support-agent/tms-client`. #402 rebuilt `get_booking_status`, but nothing gives it a client yet.

[2] "pull-403" section 2:
## Why

OLT hasn't sent a key. A dummy key would only get every request refused by the real TMS, so the test environment gets a stand-in, as the login did (#396).

[3] "pull-403" section 3:
## Approach

- **`TMS_MODE`** is required, and is `stand-in` or `live`, as #399 asks (FR-057). Both register `get_booking_status` through one TMS client built at startup (`apps/api/src/tms/tmsConnection.ts`). No mode leaves the tool out.
- **The stand-in** (FR-058):
  - It replays the saved responses in `apps/api/stand-in-tms`: made-up orders and shipments for customers 10001 and 10002, an outage that escalates, and a network failure. Its README lists them.
  - It never makes a network request. A reference with no saved response answers 404, as OLT's API does for an unknown one, so asking about someone else's booking looks the same as asking about a reference that doesn't exist.
  - It warns `tms.stand_in` once at startup, like `auth.stand_in_login`.
  - Its responses pass the CR-005 personal-data scan, in a test and in CI.
  - The image already ships `apps/api`, so the data needs no Dockerfile change.
- **Live:**
  - `config.ts` reads `TMS_API_KEY` once, plus an https `TMS_BASE_URL` through the client's own reader, and the api sends the key as `x-api-key` on each request (FR-040, FR-041).

[4] "pull-403" section 4:
## Approach

- No tool or `TmsCall` signature carries the key, and the client still reads no credential itself, which settles RD-2 on #16's side.
  - `tmsKeyLeakTurn.test.ts` drives a composed turn on the live connection with the TMS answering 500. The key goes out on every attempt and reaches no frame, tool result, audit row, escalation row or log line. `toolCrashTurn` now shares that composition (`test/fixtures/composedTurn.ts`).
- **Authority:** `get_booking_status` gets a `read_only` row in the authority table, which `docs/human-oversight.md` lists.
- **Chart:**
  - `api.tmsMode` is required and is `stand-in` or `live`. Live also needs `api.tmsBaseUrl` and the Secret `api.tmsSecretName`, key `apiKey`; the key never goes in a values file.
  - A CI step pins the default render and refuses an empty mode, `off`, an unknown mode and an incomplete live mode (FR-059).
- **`recinq-test` runs `stand-in`** until OLT sends a key (#401).

[5] "pull-403" section 5:
## Approach

- **What the web sees:** the tool registers everywhere, so the connected frame carries its two example prompts. The shipment example now names `SHP-2026-000101`, which the stand-in holds. `toolDescriptions` loses its "awaiting registration" exception, which was written to fail once the tool registered (chat FR-104).

[6] "pull-403" section 6:
## Alternatives rejected

- **A dummy key.** The real TMS would answer 401 every time, and testers would see nothing but error cards.
- **An `off` mode** that registers no TMS tool. It was in the first version of this PR, to keep `recinq-test` quiet until the chat could draw a card. #399 asks for `stand-in | live` only, and the merge order above covers the timing, so `off` is gone.
- **A real TMS key in the stand-in.** Even a placeholder secret proves nothing and invites someone to put a real one there.

## ADR references

None new.

## Spec

- `support-agent-tms-access`: FR-040 and FR-041 cite tests, FR-057 to FR-059 are new, RD-2 is settled, and the repo-state note is updated.
- FR-043, FR-044, story 3's scenario and the two shipment edge cases follow the 2026-10-15 decision: payer or orderer, and a shipment naming no customer takes its order's.
- `support-agent-tms-tools`: RD-2 is settled to match. FR-008 and FR-022 follow, and so does the client README.
- `support-agent-chat`: FR-104's exception for `get_booking_status` is gone, and FR-103 cites the renamed recorder test.

[7] "pull-403" section 7:
## Spec

**Local development:** `npm start` now needs `TMS_MODE` in your `.env`. Copy the new line from `.env.example` (`TMS_MODE=stand-in`) to try `get_booking_status` against the made-up bookings.

**Verification:**

- `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` pass on a clean `npm ci`: api 615 tests and web 246, at 100% coverage; the browser suite passes 20.
- `helm lint --strict`, kubeconform and the TMS chart step pass.
- Both fixture scans report 0 findings, and the recorded `tool-names.json` matches the recorder.
- `npx re-lint-reanchor --check` reports 0 stale, 0 unmapped and 0 rotten.

[6] "pull-403" section 6:
## Alternatives rejected

- **A dummy key.** The real TMS would answer 401 every time, and testers would see nothing but error cards.
- **An `off` mode** that registers no TMS tool. It was in the first version of this PR, to keep `recinq-test` quiet until the chat could draw a card. #399 asks for `stand-in | live` only, and the merge order above covers the timing, so `off` is gone.
- **A real TMS key in the stand-in.** Even a placeholder secret proves nothing and invites someone to put a real one there.
